driver: STM32N6 RCC low-level (LL) driver - ST STM32CubeN6 code (brownfield pilot, feature 008)

source_documents: RM0486 Rev 4 chapter 14 + memory map p.176
target.hsi_contract: RM0486 Rev 4 ch.14 RCC register interface + memory map p.176 (owner decision 2026-10-15)
target.safety_allocation: OUT_OF_SCOPE: QM development, no safety allocation or safety claims (owner decision 2026-10-15)

scope: LL (header-only, __STATIC_INLINE functions) as delivered by ST: register access through the CMSIS device structure RCC (stm32n6xx.h), using the RCC set/clear registers (RCC_CSR/RCC_CCR, RCC_AHB1ENSR/ENCR, RCC_AHB1RSTSR/RSTCR) where ST does
HSI and HSE oscillator enable/disable and ready-flag query in RCC_SR (no waiting: the caller bounds its polling)
Peripheral clock enable/disable/is-enabled and reset assert/release for GPDMA1 and ADC12 on AHB1 (functions taking the peripheral mask, e.g. LL_AHB1_GRP1_EnableClock(LL_AHB1_GRP1_PERIPH_GPDMA1))
Out of scope: HAL API, PLL configuration, clock tree switching, security/privilege configuration, interrupts, low-power modes, other peripherals and buses

budgets.status: development targets set by the work-order owner (2026-10-15)

guideline: inputs/hal_driver_guideline.md (ST Cube2 HAL SAD v1.2; automated subset = checklist SWE3-07)
layer_note: Feature 008 pilot: ST's existing STM32CubeN6 LL code (stm32n6xx-hal-driver v1.4.0), FROZEN. Requirements are derived from RM0486 independently of the code; secure build (CMSIS selects RCC_S at 0x56028000).

scope.note: HSI/HSE on/off/ready; AHB1 clock enable/disable/query and reset assert/release, used for GPDMA1 and ADC12

dependencies.origin: CMSIS core headers shipped in STMicroelectronics STM32CubeN6 v1.4.0
